# SD18 deterministic Human Fighter level 14 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic Human Fighter pilot from the bounded
# level 13 (third weapon-training group) tranche to level 14 as chosen input
# only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam and the
# deterministic Longsword / Chain Shirt / no-shield posture. Level 14 IS a
# bonus-feat cadence level (1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, ...), so this fixture
# adds the choice:fighter_bonus_feat_14 selection (canonically Greater Weapon
# Specialization, whose prerequisites -- fighter level 12, Weapon Focus and
# Weapon Specialization with the chosen weapon -- are honestly met by the
# canonical loadout). No new weapon-training group is chosen at level 14
# (the rank stays 3; the next rise is level 17).
